deviations.label: POINT (1 2) trailing
deviations.why: betterknown stops after one geometry; mbmap/data reads geometries to the end and refuses other text

deviations.label: POINT (1a 2)
deviations.why: betterknown's parseFloat takes a number's prefix; mbmap/data refuses the field

deviations.label: POINT (1 2 3)
deviations.why: betterknown refuses Z without a tag; mbmap/data takes 2 to 4 ordinates when untagged, as GDAL's older WKT writes them

deviations.label: <http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/epsg/0/4326>POINT (1 2)
deviations.why: betterknown takes an OGC CRS URI prefix; mbmap/data does not

deviations.label: SRID 3857
deviations.why: wkx keeps any SRID; mbmap/data refuses SRIDs other than 4326 (and 0)

deviations.label: byte order 2
deviations.why: wkx reads any byte but 0 as little-endian

deviations.label: MultiPoint of a LineString
deviations.why: wkx takes members of any type

deviations.label: trailing bytes
deviations.why: wkx ignores bytes after the geometry; mbmap/data reads geometries to the end
